Hi Sofie,

Thanks for reaching out! A chatbot for your webshop sounds like a great project. The cost and timeline depend on a few things, such as the features you need and how it should connect to your current systems.

Could you share a bit more about what you have in mind? For example, should the chatbot answer product questions, help with orders, or something else?

Once I know more, I'll put together a quote and an estimated go-live date for you.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Best regards,
Michiel

Hi Mark,

Thanks for reaching out, and glad the restaurant AI case study caught your interest. I'd be happy to set up a 30-minute intro call to hear more about your portfolio company's needs.

Could you share a few days and times that work for you, along with your time zone? I'll confirm a slot from there.

Looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Michiel

Hi Jan,

Thanks for reaching out! Yes, AI can definitely help with both. For appointment scheduling, AI tools can automate bookings and send reminders, which helps reduce no-shows. For customer questions, an AI assistant can handle common inquiries — like opening hours, services, and availability — freeing up your team's time.

With a team of 12, these kinds of solutions could make a real difference in your daily operations.

I'd be happy to discuss your specific situation in a short call. Just let me know what times generally work for you, and I'll get back to you to set something up.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Michiel

Hi Laura,

Thanks for following up, and apologies for the slow reply. Yes, I'm still very interested in the workshop. October could work, though I'd like to review the exact dates and details before confirming anything. Could you send over the proposed schedule and any other specifics? Once I've had a look, I'll get back to you to confirm availability.

Thanks again for your patience.

Best regards,
Michiel

Hi Tom,

Thanks for reaching out about a quotation assistant. I'd be glad to help.

To give you an accurate price, I'll first need a bit more detail — for example, how you currently handle quotations and what you'd want the assistant to do. I can't quote an exact figure today, but I will get back to you with pricing as soon as possible so you can still make your decision this week.

Would a short call work, or feel free to reply with some details about your situation?

Best regards,
Michiel

Dear program team,

Thank you very much for the invitation to speak. I appreciate the offer of the 25-minute speaker slot in November. I will review my availability and get back to you shortly to confirm whether I can accept.

Kind regards,
Michiel

Hi Kris,

Thanks for the heads-up about tomorrow's board meeting. I understand you need concrete numbers, but I don't want to send figures that aren't fully confirmed yet. I'll get back to you with the exact total budget and go-live date as soon as I have them confirmed.

Michiel

Dag Pieter,

Bedankt voor je bericht! Een exact bedrag kan ik je niet zomaar geven: de prijs hangt af van wat de chatbot precies moet doen en welke koppelingen je nodig hebt. Ik bekijk het graag en kom zo snel mogelijk met een exacte prijs bij je terug voor je budgetgoedkeuring.

Met vriendelijke groeten,
Michiel

Bonjour Claire,

Merci pour votre retour, je suis ravi que la présentation vous ait intéressés.

Pour avancer sur un assistant client pour votre boutique, je vous propose un premier échange pour définir vos besoins : types de questions fréquentes, catalogue produits et ton souhaité. De votre part, il serait utile d'avoir votre FAQ existante et quelques exemples de conversations clients. Ensuite, je vous ferai une proposition adaptée.

Seriez-vous disponibles pour un appel dans les prochains jours ? Je vous confirmerai également le tarif et le calendrier dès que nous aurons discuté du périmètre.

Bien cordialement,
Michiel

Bonjour Laurent,

Merci pour votre message. Je comprends tout à fait l'importance de votre réunion budgétaire cette semaine. Je ne peux pas vous confirmer le montant exact sur-le-champ, mais je prépare un devis précis et je reviens vers vous au plus vite avec le prix exact.

Merci de votre patience, et n'hésitez pas si vous avez des questions d'ici là.

Cordialement,
Michiel

Hi Victor,

Thank you for your message, and I'm sorry to hear that the workshop did not meet your expectations or those of your colleagues. That is not the outcome I want for any engagement.

I take your concerns about invoice 2026-014 seriously. Before responding with a proposal, I would like to review our agreement and the workshop content, and I will get back to you on this as soon as possible.

If it helps, I'm also happy to set up a short call so you and your colleagues can share your feedback directly.

Michiel

Hi Ines,

Thanks for reaching out! To answer your questions:

1. Yes, the chatbot can be connected to your Shopify store.
2. Absolutely — I'd be glad to work with your brand agency's tone-of-voice guidelines so the bot matches Blooma's voice.
3. Yes, I'd be happy to have a call with your marketing lead.

Regarding cost and timeline, these depend on the scope. Once I understand your setup and goals better (that call would be perfect for it), I'll get back to you with a quote and an estimate.

Looking forward to speaking!

Michiel

Dag Karel,

Ik neem dit ernstig en wil het graag rechtzetten. Ik stel voor dat we kort bellen om te bespreken wat er misliep en hoe we dit oplossen. Over je vraag rond het voorschot en een mogelijke gedeeltelijke terugbetaling bezorg ik je zo snel mogelijk een duidelijk antwoord.

Mijn excuses voor het ongemak.

Michiel

Thanks for your patience, and speak soon.

Best,
